subject.title: Feature: add gateway.controlUi.timezone for Control UI timestamp rendering

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public `gateway.controlUi.timezone` config/bootstrap contract for Control UI timestamp rendering, and if so should it use the linked PR's host/IANA-only shape or a browser/host/user/IANA model?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config keys and the remaining choice is product/API direction rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Accept After PR Contract Fixes
options.body: Review the linked PR, require docs/proof and composition with `timeFormat`, then land if maintainers accept the config shape.

options.title: Narrow The Config Shape
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose a smaller contract, such as only explicit IANA zones or only reusing `agents.defaults.userTimezone`.

options.title: Reject A Core Config Key
options.body: Close the feature direction after documenting that Control UI timestamps remain browser-local and browser privacy settings are the supported override point.

recommendation.title: Accept After PR Contract Fixes
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR, require docs/proof and composition with `timeFormat`, then land if maintainers accept the config shape.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the public Gateway/Control UI bootstrap and config contract, and steipete appears in the shared bootstrap contract history.
